description: Imports up to 20 public games at a time from a verified BattleBase account, skipping unfinished or already imported games. Use a username when linking a new account after the player adds their verification code to their tagline. Confirm the import first, then repeat with nextCursor as before until nextCursor is null. Retrying the same page is safe. Requires mcp:manage.

before.description: The nextCursor from an earlier import call. Omit on the first call.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: import_battlebase_history
title: Import finished games from BattleBase
